description: This file contains a class `NvidiaNimConfig` that extends `OpenAIGPTConfig` to provide configuration and parameter mapping for Nvidia NIM's Chat Completion API. It includes methods to determine supported OpenAI parameters based on model names and to map given parameters to the appropriate configuration for API calls.

classes.name: NvidiaNimConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Nvidia NIM's Chat Completion API, providing parameter support and mapping methods.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters based on the provided model name.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps given non-default and optional parameters to the supported parameters for a specific model.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
